common: Original illustration for an animated documentary film. Match the attached reference sheets' warm clean painted editorial cel animation style: tidy readable silhouettes, natural anatomy, hand-painted muted palette, precise dark ink contours, subtle tactile brushwork, quiet cinematic lighting. No photographic realism, no geometric icon look. A perfect full-bleed 2x2 sheet of four distinct 16:9 film frames in one 16:9 image, equal rectangles, no gutters, no margins, no borders. Absolutely no text, letters, digits, logos, inscriptions or watermarks anywhere (any inscriptions on buildings are left blank). Keep the primary subject above the bottom subtitle safe area. Recurring invented character Ji-woo: Korean woman about 30, shoulder-length slightly wavy black hair (match the attached night reference sheet's woman's face), wearing a mustard-yellow raincoat over a grey hoodie, dark jeans, white sneakers, a small crossbody bag; the same face and clothing in every frame she appears. In the imagined ancient Roman building-site frames she is a time-travelling visitor: same face and hair, same mustard-yellow raincoat over a grey hoodie, now with a wide leather tool belt and dusty sneakers, standing among ancient Roman workers in plain tunics. The building under construction is the round Pantheon rotunda in Rome around 120 AD: thick round brick-faced concrete drum, a hemispherical concrete dome built over curved wooden centering (formwork) and timber scaffolding. The Pantheon in Rome must look architecturally correct: porch with 16 granite columns and triangular pediment, round rotunda, interior hemispherical coffered dome with 5 rings of square recessed coffers and a round open oculus at the top, polychrome marble floor of circles and squares.

sheets.build1: Top left: wide sunny ancient Roman building site, Ji-woo holding a long rope tied to a wooden stake in the middle of a huge flat cleared ground, walking in a giant circle and scratching its outline into the earth, Roman workers watching, the circle so large that four ancient ox carts parked end to end fit across it. Top right: the round brick-faced drum wall already standing, a huge curved wooden centering framework of the dome rising above it on timber scaffolding, workers carrying baskets on ramps, Ji-woo on the scaffolding pointing. Bottom left: on top of the wooden centering, workers pouring and tamping grey concrete in one even layer of the same thickness all around the curved formwork, Ji-woo with a trowel smoothing it, sun and dust. Bottom right: the plain uniform dome right after the wooden formwork is removed, long vertical cracks splitting open around the lower part of the dome near its base, bits of concrete dust falling, Ji-woo below looking up in alarm with hands on her head.
sheets.build2: Top left: close-up of the base of the dome being rebuilt very thick: a massive wall of concrete many times taller than a person, Ji-woo standing beside it looking tiny, measuring with an outstretched arm, workers laying another course. Top right: exterior view of the rising dome on the round drum, workers adding a series of stepped concrete rings around the outside of the lower dome like giant stairs pressing down on its base, Ji-woo on a ladder patting the step. Bottom left: three big wicker baskets of aggregate on the building site: heavy grey-white stone chunks, broken orange bricks, and very light porous grey pumice; Ji-woo dropping a pumice stone into a wooden bucket of water where it floats, smiling in surprise. Bottom right: a warm memory flashback: a small Korean child (young Ji-woo, about 6, bob haircut) on a living-room floor stacking colourful wooden toy blocks into a tall tower, placing a big heavy block on top and the tower wobbling, soft afternoon light.
sheets.build3: Top left: under the half-built dome, workers on scaffolding pressing square stepped wooden box molds into the wet concrete of the ceiling to make deep square recessed coffers in neat rings, Ji-woo helping push one mold. Top right: the nearly finished dome seen from inside, the top left open as a large round hole to the bright sky, Ji-woo standing on high scaffolding at the hole's rim looking up through it at clouds. Bottom left: the first rain falls through the round open hole onto the new floor, workers have laid a polychrome marble floor slightly raised in the middle with a few small round drain holes right below the opening, water running outward into the drains, Ji-woo crouching to watch the water disappear. Bottom right: years later, the finished Pantheon interior, fine long vertical hairline cracks visible on the lower part of the dome above the drum, the upper dome intact, Ji-woo with her palm on the wall looking up, calm and relieved, soft light from the oculus.
sheets.lime: Top left: at the Roman concrete mixing trough, a Roman worker in a tunic tossing pale white chunks of quicklime straight into the wet mortar, a puff of hot steam rising, Ji-woo leaning back surprised. Top right: macro close-up of the steaming freshly mixed grey Roman mortar with small unmixed bright white lumps scattered through it, volcanic ash and stone fragments. Bottom left: a modern construction site at dusk, Ji-woo in a white hard hat over her raincoat beside a tall wooden column form with a dense steel rebar cage inside, a concrete pump hose pouring fresh concrete into it. Bottom right: close-up of a modern concrete column surface in a damp underground garage, a thin crack with rainwater slowly seeping into it, a faint orange rust stain starting below it, cold fluorescent light, no people.
